desc: Parse N,S,T; build f[c] from each S[i]->T[i]; print -1 if any letter of S maps to two different T letters.
Print -1 when |distinct(S)|==26 and |distinct(T)|==26 and S != T (non-identity permutation on full alphabet, no spare label).
Implemented cost = E + (number of length>=2 cycles whose every node has in-degree exactly 1), with E = #{present c : f(c)!=c}; passed all 4 public samples.
Brute-force verified the cost model and -1 rule against BFS on small alphabets (k=2,3,4); no mismatches.
Final self-contained stdin->stdout program is complete and emits the verified answer.
